title: Error types with needed/available context are actionable
description:
The error types in error.rs include both what was needed and what was available:

```rust
pub struct BufferTooSmall {
    pub needed: usize,
    pub available: usize,
}

pub struct TooShort {
    pub needed: usize,
    pub available: usize,
}
```

Display output: "buffer too small: need 256 bytes, have 128"

This is good practice worth defending:
- Errors are immediately actionable (caller knows how much buffer to provide)
- Debugging is faster (no need to trace back to find actual sizes)
- The pattern is consistent across both error types
- Works well in no_std (no format! allocation, just integer formatting)
